name: pickle-glass

scripts.predev: pnpm install --silent && pnpm -C pickleglass_web install --silent && pnpm exec electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:renderer && NO_DEVTOOLS=1 NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.predev:tools: pnpm install --silent && pnpm -C pickleglass_web install --silent && pnpm exec electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.preintv: pnpm install --silent && pnpm -C pickleglass_web install --silent && pnpm exec electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.intv: pnpm run build:renderer && NO_DEVTOOLS=1 APP_MODE=intv NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.predev:npm: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --progress=false && npm --prefix pickleglass_web ci --no-audit --no-fund --progress=false && npx electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.dev:npm: npm run build:renderer && NO_DEVTOOLS=1 NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.preintv:npm: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --progress=false && npm --prefix pickleglass_web ci --no-audit --no-fund --progress=false && npx electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.intv:npm: npm run build:renderer && NO_DEVTOOLS=1 APP_MODE=intv NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.build: pnpm run build:all && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.publish: pnpm run build:all && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.postinstall: if [ -z "$SKIP_APP_DEPS" ]; then electron-builder install-app-deps; else echo 'Skipping electron app deps'; fi
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:renderer & pnpm -C pickleglass_web run build & wait

nodemonConfig.exec: pnpm run build:renderer && NO_DEVTOOLS=1 NODE_ENV=development electron .

comments: dev: installs deps (predev), rebuilds natives, then builds once and launches Electron with NO_DEVTOOLS=1 and NODE_ENV=development
dev:watch: watches app sources; on change, rebuilds renderer and restarts Electron automatically
intv: installs deps (preintv), clean build, then launch with NO_DEVTOOLS=1 and NODE_ENV=production (APP_MODE=intv)
watch:renderer remains available if you want live rebuilds (then restart dev on changes)
build:all runs renderer + Next export in parallel using shell backgrounding & wait; used by package/publish
Fallback npm: use npm run dev:npm, npm run dev:watch:npm, or npm run intv:npm if pnpm isn’t available
